d40: 🕯️ Gabriela is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

echoSample: d43: "You want to know about that? Okay." "Gabriela is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
d43: "I keep turning over the last thing Gabriela said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
d43: "The fire feels smaller without Gabriela. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
d43: "Gabriela owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."

lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Gabriela Reilly is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Gabriela is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d40: 🕯️ Gabriela Reilly is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Gabriela kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Gabriela's gone." Michelle looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Gabriela." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ingrid blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Fine Woodworking (Level 1). Joints that hold without nails: mortise, tenon, and the humble dovetail.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Repair & Mending (Level 1). Look at what's broken before you touch it: find the failure point, not the symptom. Most breaks are one small thing.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d40: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Gabriela Reilly, 40 days. The mantle passes to Ingrid Owens.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ingrid Owens, 30 — a carpenter. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Echo Location, Dowsing, Berserker Rage.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Gabriela — and Gabriela is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Javier, Michelle, Muna and 5 more speak for Ingrid — "Gabriela trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Ingrid before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

d81: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.

d81: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d81: 🕯️ Ingrid's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Stonebridge. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d81: 🕯️ Ingrid Owens is dead — dehydration. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d81: What Ingrid kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d81: "Ingrid's gone." Michelle looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Ingrid." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d81: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Javier blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d81: 📖 LEARNED: Pipes & Waterworks (Level 1). Water follows gravity and the path of least resistance. Find the line, find the water.
d81: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d81: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d81: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d81: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Ingrid Owens, 81 days. The mantle passes to Javier Ross.
d81: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Javier Ross, 30 — a plumber. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Scream Cheese.
d81: The village's quarrel was with Ingrid — and Ingrid is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d81: You knew Ingrid — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
d81: At the grave, Michelle, Muna, Hassan and 5 more speak for Javier — "Ingrid trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d81: The fire knew Javier before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d111: Overnight, 6 Burdock; 4 Burdock; 6 Hickory Nuts (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
d111: Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
d111: 💬 Priya says: "Do you think they're watching right now? The... audience? I try not to think about it."
d111: Whatever was at the door has moved on — or found easier meat. The call goes quiet.
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+1 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
